thread:
morgan: Heads up — I'm scheduling a 12h overnight soak tonight (mixed k6 replay + locust user journeys) to investigate the long-tail token latency regressions we've seen in Canary. Need quick ✅ on smoke gates + who can own profiling hooks.

heather: I can take profiling (flamegraphs + jemalloc snapshots). What markers do you want in the runtime traces?

morgan: thanks. Please capture: kv-cache hit/miss, batch sizes, and sequence-length distribution. If possible attach p99/p999 CPU stacks every 10m.

sanjay: I'll stand up the Locust scenario for the replayed traffic. Which traffic window are we replaying? full-prod-tuesday-2100-2215?

morgan: yes — that 75m window but stretched across 12h with bursts preserved. Locust for stateful flows (chat + tool calls), k6 for the high-volume stateless prompts.

alex: small ask — can we bump dedicated pool to 1.5x for the test start window to avoid immediate failovers? Otherwise we'll get noisy fallback metrics.

morgan: good call. @tj can you approve capacity bump?

tj: approving. I'm increasing target capacity now. Will post when done.

ci-bot: smoke-checks: unit-tests: passed, integration-smoke: passed, infra-health: degraded -> 1 non-critical disk iops alert (investigating).

heather: here are the commands I'll use to collect stacks and flamegraphs. Drop these on the perf node before start:
```
# capture pprof stacks every 10m for pid 1234
while true; do go tool pprof -seconds 30 http://localhost:6060/debug/pprof/profile -output /tmp/pprof-$(date +%s).pb; sleep 600; done &

# jemalloc stats snapshot
echo 'stats' | nc localhost 3333 > /tmp/jemalloc-$(date +%s).txt
```
I'll also push a lightweight agent that emits kv-cache hits as a custom metric.

morgan: perfect. Can you also enable log sampling at 1% for traces that hit p999? We only want a few heavy traces.

heather: will do.

alex: Sanjay, for locust can you include think-time jitter and preserve session stickiness? Last time the replay was too uniform.

sanjay: yep — using the session cookie map and random think_time between 0.5-3s. Locustfile snippet: 
```python
class User(TaskSet):
    @task(10)
    def chat(self):
        self.client.post('/api/chat', json={'input': payload()}, headers={'Cookie': self.session})
```
I'll push the full locustfile to the runbook.

morgan: runbook link: https://internal.redwood/runbooks/soak/2033333333 (will update after start). Please annotate any anomaly with #soak-tag so we can grep later.

tj: capacity bump is live — scaled pool to 1.5x and pinned an extra quantized model variant to avoid fallback.

deploy-bot: deploy queued: perf-agent-v2 -> staging -> canary. Estimated finish: 5m.

alex: I'll watch routing and fallback alarms. If fallbacks > 0.5% for more than 2m, we abort.

morgan: agreed. Abort condition: fallbacks > 0.5% for 2m OR p99 token latency > 2s sustained for 5m.

heather: profiling agent deployed to all test nodes. Starting periodic pprof capture in 2m.

sanjay: locust master starting in 3m. k6 scripts ready. I'll post start and stop times in followup.

morgan: thanks team. If you're on-call tonight please ping here with any handoffs. I'll be available until 1am PT then hand off to heather.

alex: noted, I'll keep watch through the first 4h.

heather: I'll own second half and do analysis on the pprof dumps in the morning.

morgan: final: please share any quick triage outputs (heap growth, rv swap, blocked threads) as short bullets here — no long writeups during the run.

sanjay: start: 2033333933. k6+locust ramping to target. Will post steady-state timestamp.

morgan: received. Good luck :thumbsup:

sanjay: steady-state reached at 2033334633. traffic profile preserved.

alex: observing small p95 blips around model load transitions at 2033335000 — investigating cache warmup.

heather: captured a couple p999 stacks showing kernel wait for epoll at 2033335100, saving artifacts now.

morgan: thanks — tag them with #soak and upload to the runbook when you're ready. We'll reconvene async with a short findings list tomorrow.
